purpose: Physically validate the selector-5 shifted alternating prelude introduced by probe .11 and compare it with the accepted stock counter-0 assignment.
interpretation: Probe .11 proved that the ESP32 and CC1101 can emit one continuous alternating stream while switching frequency offset and deviation at the 256-symbol boundary.
The ordinary wake, frame carrier, decoded payload, and 50.7 ms request-end timing remained aligned with the accepted stock exchange.

The shifted prelude was real but over-shifted and over-deviated. Cross-referencing the measured ordinary 0x45 waveform with the accepted HTV405 path maps the stock ratios to FSCTRL0 offset 12 and DEVIATN 0x46.
Probe .12 must change only those two prelude registers; the ordinary assignment and all later state-machine fields remain frozen.
